Comfort
Larger text and buttons, more contrast, no motion.
Items travel through an ntfy relay, end-to-end encrypted. Changing it changes the pairing code: senders pair again.

ntfy.sh, the default relay, is free and needs no account. It keeps links for 12 hours and files for 3 hours, takes files in parts of up to 2 MB (Send to Daylight sends files of up to 9 MB that way), and lets each network send about 250 messages and 200 MB a day. Another ntfy server works if anyone can use it without a login and it accepts files of at least 2 MB; the Inbox checks that before saving it.

Which app gets the items. Automatic is the Daylight Reader; any other app that takes saved pages or documents (such as a side-by-side test copy of the Reader) can be chosen here. What the chosen app doesn’t take goes to Automatic.
